_readme: Bob games blocklist (safety.md S2, S8). A child-safety CONTENT filter, never a language-understanding rule.
Source: a subset of the LDNOOBW English list (List-of-Dirty-Naughty-Obscene-and-Otherwise-Bad-Words,
additions for a kids' product (violence, drugs, scary and adult themes).
Review: every entry must be read by a human before merge; record the reviewer and date in 'review'.
How matching works (word-filter.ts): input is NFKC-folded, lower-cased, stripped of accents, homoglyphs and
leetspeak are folded, and repeated letters are squashed. 'words' then match a WHOLE token (or the joined
tokens, which catches 'f u c k'), also after stripping a plural or verb suffix (-s, -es, -ed, -ing, -er, -y).
'substrings' match anywhere, so only list roots that no common benign English word contains
('cunt' is NOT a substring entry because of 'Scunthorpe'; 'ass' is not because of 'grass' and 'assist').
To extend: add the lower-case base form to 'words' (no plurals needed), add a benign word that must still
pass to the table in apps/api/tests/games-engine.test.ts, and run that test.
